text:
Aisha: Heads-up — we need a policy-versioning + deprecation plan for RBAC. Legacy roles (org_admin_v1, svc_role_legacy) slated for removal in ~2 weeks. Staging showed auth errors when some service tokens hit the new runtime. Who owns rollout & docs?

Tom: I can lead. Proposed plan: 1) introduce policy v2 with explicit capability mapping; 2) provide aliasing layer for 2 weeks; 3) SDKs expose Role enum + migrate helper; 4) tag audit logs with policy_version. Canary: 10% → 50% → 100%.

Priya: +1. Also call out KMS implications — if we rotate or change key ARNs some service accounts may lack kms:Decrypt on the new key. Add a preflight KMS permission check in migration.

Marco: FYI we found a role-alias bug: the "viewer_readonly" alias was accidentally granting iam:write via a stale mapping. Repro steps below.

Marco: ```bash
# reproduce locally
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \n  -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/deploys \n  -d '{"model":"gpt-redwood","route":"/test"}'
# response: 403 initially, then 500 when mapping hit null
```

infra-bot: deploy-notifier: Canary rollout started for rbac-service v2 (canary=10%) by @Tom - https://ci.redwood.ai/1234 :rocket:

Aisha: Can someone assemble a short troubleshooting checklist for platform engineers + customer SAs? Need quick causes for 403, common KMS errors, and audit-log query samples to run.

Tom: Draft checklist: - check policy_version in audit log (policy.version) - inspect role_alias table for collisions: `SELECT * FROM role_alias WHERE alias = 'viewer_readonly';` - verify service-account bindings include kms:Decrypt for new key - rollback via feature-flag `rbac_v2_enable=false`

Tom: SDK migration snippet:```python
# python SDK migration helper
from redwood import RBACClient
RBACClient.migrate_service_account(sa_id, from_version="v1", to_version="v2", dry_run=True)
```

Priya: Telemetry to watch: 403 rate, 500 rate, kms.decrypt_failure_count, audit gaps (missing policy.version). Suggest alerts: 403 > baseline*5 for 5m; kms.decrypt_failure_count > 10 in 10m.

Marco: Customer impact note — CS reported one customer automation broke because they referenced an inline legacy role string. Need an email template + rollback instructions.

Aisha: Owners: Tom (rollout), Priya (KMS & alerts), Marco (bugfix & customer comms), Aisha (docs + release notes). Please ack.

Tom: ack :white_check_mark:
Priya: ack :white_check_mark:
Marco: ack :white_check_mark:

Aisha: Added checklist to docs PR #789 — https://git.redwood.ai/p/docs/+/789 :memo:

Priya: Audit log sample to include in docs:
```
resource.type="service_account"
protoPayload.request.headers.policyVersion="v2"
```

Marco: I'm starting a hotfix for the alias collision in rbac-service. ETA ~2h.

infra-bot: incident-bot: Created incident INC-2027-042 for alias-collision. Assignees: Marco, Tom.

Aisha: Thanks all — we'll reconvene after canary evaluation at 11:30.
